title.zh: 【Initia 链疑遭无限铸币攻击，攻击者已套现约 260 万美元】
title.en: 【Initia 链疑遭无限铸币攻击，攻击者已套现约 260 万美元】

current_state.zh: Initia L1 主网及所有 Rollup 仍处于暂停状态；联合创始人称漏洞可能源于 MoveVM Day 0 漏洞，原生代币 INIT 未受影响，团队仍在调查影响及后续细节。
current_state.en: Initia's L1 mainnet and all Rollups remain paused; the co-founder said the exploit likely stemmed from a MoveVM Day 0 vulnerability, the native INIT token was unaffected, and the team is still investigating the impact and further details.

updates.title_zh: 【Initia 链疑遭无限铸币攻击，攻击者已套现约 260 万美元】
updates.title_en: 【Initia 链疑遭无限铸币攻击，攻击者已套现约 260 万美元】
updates.what_changed_zh: 安全研究员 spreekaway 指出，Initia 疑似遭遇无限增发漏洞，多个代币被任意增发，攻击者已套现约 260 万美元的 ETH，同时在 Initia 上仍持有约 454 万美元的 iUSD、USDC、AUSD 和 ETH。
updates.what_changed_en: Security researcher spreekaway flagged that Initia appears to have suffered an unlimited-mint exploit in which multiple tokens were arbitrarily minted, with the attacker cashing out about $2.6M in ETH while still holding roughly $4.54M in iUSD, USDC, AUSD and ETH on Initia.

updates.current_state_en: Security researcher spreekaway flagged that Initia appears to have suffered an unlimited-mint exploit in which multiple tokens were arbitrarily minted, with the attacker cashing out about $2.6M in ETH while still holding roughly $4.54M in iUSD, USDC, AUSD and ETH on Initia.

updates.title_zh: Initia因安全事件暂停L1主网及Rollup运行
updates.title_en: Initia因安全事件暂停L1主网及Rollup运行
updates.what_changed_zh: Initia 因该安全事件暂停了 L1 主网及所有 Rollup 运行，并正与安全团队、验证者及交易所协作评估影响。
updates.what_changed_en: Initia halted its L1 mainnet and all Rollups due to the security incident and is coordinating with security teams, validators, and exchanges to assess the impact.
updates.current_state_zh: Initia 在安全事件后已暂停 L1 主网及所有 Rollup，团队正调查影响范围并提醒用户警惕非官方信息。
updates.current_state_en: Initia has paused its L1 mainnet and all Rollups following the security incident while the team investigates the impact and warns users about unofficial information.
updates.detailed_summary_zh: Initia halted its L1 mainnet and all Rollups as of 23:41:30 (UTC+8) on October 23, 2026 following a security incident, with the team coordinating with security firms, validators, and exchanges to assess the impact and warning users against unofficial links and claims circulating during the outage.
updates.detailed_summary_en: Initia halted its L1 mainnet and all Rollups as of 23:41:30 (UTC+8) on October 23, 2026 following a security incident, with the team coordinating with security firms, validators, and exchanges to assess the impact and warning users against unofficial links and claims circulating during the outage.

updates.title_zh: Initia联创：漏洞攻击涉及MoveVM，原生代币INIT未受影响
updates.title_en: Initia联创：漏洞攻击涉及MoveVM，原生代币INIT未受影响
updates.what_changed_zh: Initia 联合创始人 Zon 表示，漏洞可能源于其基于 Cosmos SDK 的 MoveVM 中的 Day 0 漏洞，该漏洞允许攻击者在 Initia L1 上额外铸造代币，但原生代币 INIT 未受影响；在链暂停前，攻击者已通过增发并跨链转移的方式转出价值约 270 万美元的 AUSD、ETH 和 USDC。
updates.what_changed_en: Initia co-founder Zon said the incident likely stemmed from a Day 0 vulnerability in its Cosmos SDK-based MoveVM that allowed extra token minting on Initia L1, while the native INIT token was unaffected; roughly $2.7M in AUSD, ETH and USDC was bridged out before the chain was paused.
updates.current_state_zh: Initia L1 主网及所有 Rollup 仍处于暂停状态；联合创始人称漏洞可能源于 MoveVM Day 0 漏洞，原生代币 INIT 未受影响，团队仍在调查影响及后续细节。
updates.current_state_en: Initia's L1 mainnet and all Rollups remain paused; the co-founder said the exploit likely stemmed from a MoveVM Day 0 vulnerability, the native INIT token was unaffected, and the team is still investigating the impact and further details.
updates.detailed_summary_zh: Initia's co-founder said a Day 0 vulnerability in its Cosmos SDK-based MoveVM let an attacker mint extra tokens on Initia L1 and bridge out roughly $2.7M in AUSD, ETH and USDC before the chain was paused, with the native INIT token unaffected.
updates.detailed_summary_en: Initia's co-founder said a Day 0 vulnerability in its Cosmos SDK-based MoveVM let an attacker mint extra tokens on Initia L1 and bridge out roughly $2.7M in AUSD, ETH and USDC before the chain was paused, with the native INIT token unaffected.
